neighbours.label: the word ' thereby' and its Chinese equivalent 从而, as opposed to therefore, consequently, 因此 and 所以
fire: The filter removes dust, thereby improving the air in the room.
Trees shade the street, thereby lowering summer temperatures.
企业降低了成本，从而提高了利润。
He signed the paper and thereby gave up his rights.
新政策增加了就业，从而促进了经济发展。
The bank raised rates, thereby slowing new lending.
通过加强锻炼，从而增强体质。
The law closed the gap, thereby ending the dispute.
quiet: The filter removes dust, so the air in the room improves.
Trees shade the street, consequently lowering summer temperatures.
企业降低了成本，因此提高了利润。
He signed the paper and then gave up his rights.
新政策增加了就业，所以促进了经济发展。
The bank raised rates, hence slowing new lending.
通过加强锻炼，也能增强体质。
The law closed the gap, therefore ending the dispute.

notes: A probe of ' thus' reached 0.31; it is left out of the near misses, so a test that included it would be harder.
